word.fits: The German name for exactly these warm late-September days, with spider silk drifting over the fields.
word.meaning: The warm, hazy days of early autumn. The name may come from an old word for spinning: the silk threads that spiders leave on the fields now.

kindness.fits: A German custom: bottles with a deposit are left standing beside the bin for whoever collects them.
kindness.text: Finished a bottle outside? Leave it standing beside the bin, not in it. Someone will collect the deposit and be glad.

lookForward.fits: Crane migration is under way across Germany in late September; the big roosts fill through October.
lookForward.headline: Cranes over the whole country this week
lookForward.line: Tens of thousands are crossing Germany on their way south. Listen for a trumpet call from high up, then look for the long V.
